title: mime-tree: RFC 8621 §4.1.4 walk algorithm
description: Callers need text_body/html_body/attachments computed views per the JMAP body structure algorithm. Implement in walk.rs the recursive multipart traversal defined in RFC 8621 §4.1.4. RFC text at ~/PROJECT/MIME/standards/rfc8621.txt. The algorithm classifies each leaf part as text body, html body, attachment, or inline attachment based on content-type, content-disposition, and multipart subtype context. Results are part IDs stored in ParsedMessage fields.
acceptance_criteria: Hand-crafted MIME fixtures with known expected structure all pass; tested against the spec, not against this crate's own output
